howItWorks.clipperTitle: 5 simple steps to your first payout

howItWorks.brandTitle: Scale your brand with viral clipping

step1.title: Pick a campaign
step1.desc: Browse active campaigns from top streamers, music labels, and brands. See pay rates, supported platforms, and bounty rules upfront.

step2.title: Connect your accounts
step2.desc: Link your TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or X handles with 1-click verification. View analytics track back to your account automatically.

step3.title: Add payout method
step3.desc: Choose your preferred payout method — PayPal or instant crypto transfers (USDC & USDT). Automatic weekly payouts.

step4.title: Drop your clips
step4.desc: Edit viral cuts, publish to your connected accounts, and submit the link. Automated tracking monitors view counts directly from the source.

step5.title: Get paid per view
step5.desc: Your earnings climb in real time as views roll in. When the cycle closes, your payout is automatically deposited.

fund.title: Fund campaign
fund.amountHint: The whole amount goes to the campaign budget.
fund.note: You pay in crypto through CryptoBot in Telegram — USDT, USDC, TON, BTC or ETH. The budget is locked for clipper payouts; unspent money comes back if the campaign is rejected.
fund.waiting: Waiting for payment… this page updates by itself.
fund.expired: This invoice expired. Create a new one.
fund.paid: Payment received. The campaign goes to review.

create.title: New campaign
create.subtitle: Four short steps. You fund it at the end and pay only for real views.
create.name: Campaign name
create.namePh: e.g. Best moments from our podcast
create.coverHint: JPG or PNG, we crop it to 16:9
create.descriptionHint: Describe the content and the moments that work best.
create.driveHint: Google Drive, Dropbox or any public folder with the raw videos.
create.do2: Strong hook in the first 3 seconds
create.do4: Tag our account in the caption
create.do5: Keep the post public for 90 days
create.dont2: No bought views, bots or engagement pods
create.dont3: No reposts of someone else’s clip
create.ratesHelp: A typical rate is $1–$3 per 1,000 views. The minimum payout stops tiny clips from draining the budget; the cap limits what one viral clip can take.
create.budgetHint: You can add more later. Minimum $10.
create.estimateNote: Budget ÷ average rate. Actual reach depends on the clips.
create.reviewNote: Next you fund the budget. After payment our team checks the brief, then the campaign goes live for clippers.
create.saved: Campaign saved. Fund it to send it for review.
create.errDrive: Paste a full link, like https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/…
create.errRate: Each rate must be between $0.01 and $100

clips.title: My clips
clips.subtitle: Every clip you submitted, with live views and earnings.
clips.emptyDesc: Pick a campaign, post a clip and paste the link — it shows up here.
clips.withdrawDesc: It will be removed from the campaign and won’t earn anything. You can only do this while it’s on hold.
clips.rule1: Views are read from the platform automatically. TikTok and Instagram views may be confirmed by our team from your analytics.
clips.rule2: Every clip waits 48 hours before it can earn, so we can spot fake views.
clips.rule3: Clips with bought views are rejected and stop earning.

acc.title: Accounts & profile
acc.subtitle: Connect the accounts you post from and set up how you look on Clipte.
acc.socialIntro: You can only submit clips from accounts you’ve verified. To prove an account is yours, put a short code in its bio for a minute.
acc.noneDesc: Connect TikTok, YouTube or Instagram to start submitting clips.
acc.handleHint: Without @ — or paste the profile link.
acc.step2: Paste it anywhere in your {p} bio and save.
acc.step3: Wait about a minute (platforms update public pages with a delay), then press the button below. You can delete the code after it’s verified.
acc.notFoundYet: We couldn’t find the code yet. Save your bio and try again in a minute.
acc.manualNote: TikTok and Instagram sometimes hide bios from our checker. If it keeps failing, leave the code in your bio — a moderator will verify the account by hand.
acc.removeAfter: After it’s verified you can remove the code from your bio.
acc.removeDesc: {h} will be disconnected. Clips you already submitted stay.
acc.name: Display name
acc.bioHint: Shown on your public profile. Up to 280 characters.
acc.emailHint: Only you and our team can see it.
acc.brandIntro: Fill this in to run campaigns. Clippers see your brand name and logo on every campaign.
acc.badSite: Use a full link, like https://example.com
acc.where_youtube: Paste it in your channel description (the “About” text people see on your channel), then publish.
acc.where_tiktok: Paste it in your TikTok bio, then save.
acc.where_instagram: Paste it in your Instagram bio, then save.

acc.pathApp_youtube: Avatar → Your channel → ✏️ → Description → paste → Save

acc.pathApp_tiktok: Profile → Edit profile → Bio → paste → Save
acc.path_instagram: instagram.com → Profile → Edit profile → Bio → paste → Submit
acc.pathApp_instagram: Profile → Edit profile → Bio → paste → Done
